title: Plural negative olla
summary: Form emme ole, ette ole, and eivät ole with plural subjects.
objectives: Choose emme, ette, or eivät from the subject.
Use ole after every plural negative verb.
Keep polite te aligned with ette ole.

sections.title: Three plural negative forms
paragraphs: For plural persons, the negative verb forms are emme, ette, and eivät. Use me emme ole, te ette ole, and he eivät ole.
Ole stays unchanged after each negative form.

sections.title: Plural and polite te
paragraphs: A group addressed as te uses ette ole. One person addressed politely as te also uses ette ole.
Read the pronoun before choosing between emme, ette, and eivät.

steps: Use the same form for polite singular te.

commonMistakes: Do not confuse emme with ette.
Do not use singular et with plural or polite te.
